scripts.dev-ai: cd services/ai && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && pnpm contracts && concurrently -k -n api,ai,web -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev-api" "pnpm dev-ai" "pnpm dev-web"
scripts.lint: pnpm contracts && pnpm -r --if-present lint && cd services/ai && uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm contracts && pnpm -r --if-present test && cd services/ai && uv run pytest -q
